_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Senegal covering Senegambian stone circles, Wolof/Jolof confederation, Gorée Island slave trade, French Four Communes, Léopold Sédar Senghor and négritude, stable democracy, and Casamance conflict.

ethnic_groups.name: Wolof
ethnic_groups.notes: Largest group; western Senegal; Wolof language lingua franca of Senegal; Jolof Empire heritage; Mouride/Tidiane brotherhoods

ethnic_groups.name: Fula/Fulani (Halpulaar)
ethnic_groups.notes: Northern Senegal (Fouta Toro); pastoralist and settled; Toucouleur sub-group; Tidianiyya Islamic order; El Hadj Umar Tall heritage

ethnic_groups.name: Serer
ethnic_groups.notes: Central-west Senegal (Sine-Saloum); historically resisted Islam longest; Senghor's ethnic group; strong cultural identity; saltie wrestling

ethnic_groups.name: Jola (Diola)
ethnic_groups.notes: Casamance region; rice farmers; Casamance separatist movement (MFDC); distinct from northern Senegal culture

ethnic_groups.name: Mandinka (Malinke/Mandingo)
ethnic_groups.notes: Eastern Senegal and Casamance; Mali Empire heritage; Kunta Kinte ancestry; Muslim

ethnic_groups.name: Soninke
ethnic_groups.notes: Northeastern Senegal; Ghana Empire descendants; migration tradition (Soninkés in France)

ethnic_groups.name: Lebou
ethnic_groups.notes: Dakar peninsula; fishing community; related to Wolof; Cap-Vert area indigenous

ethnic_groups.name: Other (Bassari, Bedik, Manjago, Moor)
ethnic_groups.notes: Southeastern ethnic minorities; Bassari and Bedik UNESCO World Heritage cultural landscapes; Moor traders

country_profile.notes_unique: Never experienced a coup; one of Africa's most stable democracies; Sufi Islamic brotherhoods (Mouridiyya, Tidianiyya) uniquely influential

natural_resources.notes: Fisheries vital (employs 600,000+); Grande Côte zircon/titanium mine (world's largest mineral sands); Sangomar oil field (first oil 2024, Woodside); GTA gas field (shared with Mauritania, BP/Kosmos); phosphate mining (ICS); peanuts traditionally major export.

military.notes: One of Africa's most professional and apolitical militaries; never experienced a coup; active in UN/AU peacekeeping (Darfur, Mali, Central Africa); ECOMOG contributor; Casamance separatist conflict (MFDC) largely dormant; French military cooperation.

infrastructure.notes: Orange, Free, Expresso telecoms; TER regional express rail; new AIBD airport; Diamniadio city (new administrative hub).

debt_aid.notes: PSE (Plan Sénégal Émergent) development plan; TER (Train Express Régional Dakar) Africa's first modern commuter rail (2022); BRT Dakar; Diamniadio new city; first oil and gas revenues expected to transform economy; CFA franc zone; Blaise Diagne International Airport (2017).

education.notes: UCAD one of Francophone Africa's largest universities (~80,000 students); daaras (Koranic schools) parallel secular system; talibé children issue; French language of instruction; bilingual Arabic-French schools growing.

diaspora_migration.diaspora_population: 3 million+ (France, Italy, Spain, USA, Gambia, Mauritania)
diaspora_migration.notes: Remittances critical (~10.5% GDP); large Mouride brotherhood diaspora network; irregular migration via canoe to Canary Islands resumed; Senegalese traders across West Africa; Casamance displacement mostly resolved.
diaspora_migration.immigration_policy: ECOWAS free movement; transit country for migration to Europe

digital_economy.notes: Wave disrupted Orange Money monopoly with lower fees; Sonatel/Orange Senegal dominant operator; SAT-3/WASC/ACE submarine cables; growing BPO sector for French-speaking market; Paydunya, InTouch fintech; Diamniadio tech city under development.

country_profile.national_motto: Un peuple, un but, une foi (One People, One Goal, One Faith)
country_profile.national_anthem: Pincez tous vos koras, frappez les balafons (Everyone strum your koras, strike the balafons)

geography.terrain: Flat plains; Casamance River region (south); semi-arid Sahel (north); Sine-Saloum Delta; Cap-Vert Peninsula (westernmost point of Africa)
geography.notes: Westernmost country in continental Africa (Cap-Vert Peninsula/Dakar); Gambia enclave within; Gorée Island (slave trade, UNESCO); GTA gas field (with Mauritania/BP).

economy_extended.notes: Strong 2024 growth (oil/gas: Sangomar oil field by Woodside, GTA gas with BP/Mauritania); PSE emergence plan; fishing/agriculture; phosphates; new leadership (Bassirou Diomaye Faye, youngest president, 2024).

health.notes: CMU (Couverture Maladie Universelle) expanding; Institut Pasteur Dakar (COVID-19 vaccine ambitions); badienu gox (community health godmothers); low HIV for West Africa.

food_agriculture.notes: Groundnut exports historically dominant; rice self-sufficiency goal; fishing sector critical (artisanal + industrial); Chinese/EU fishing agreements controversial.

energy.notes: GTA gas field (first gas expected 2024-25); Sangomar oil field (first oil 2024, Woodside); Scaling Solar programme; SENELEC utility; targets energy transformation.

major_airports_international: Blaise Diagne International Airport (Diass, near Dakar)
transport.notes: TER (Dakar regional express rail, 2022); Dakar-Diamniadio motorway; new AIBD airport (2017, 10M pax capacity); Dakar port major transit hub.

tourism.notes: 7 UNESCO sites (2nd most in West Africa); Gorée Island iconic; Teranga (hospitality) brand; beach tourism; music/culture tourism.

human_rights_gender.notes: 2024 democratic transition celebrated (Bassirou Diomaye Faye won); 2023 political crisis (Macky Sall third-term attempt); parity law (44% women in parliament); talibé children (forced begging).

security_stability.notes: Relatively stable; Casamance conflict (40+ years, mostly resolved under Sall/Faye); ECOWAS leader; strong peacekeeping contributor; 2024 power transition democratic milestone.

cultural_heritage.national_dish: Thiéboudienne (rice and fish, UNESCO Intangible Heritage 2021)
notable_historical_figures: Léopold Sédar Senghor (1st president, poet, Négritude)
cultural_heritage.media_landscape: RTS state; TFM, 2STV, Walf (private TV); Sud FM; relatively diverse media landscape
cultural_heritage.notes: Négritude movement; Teranga (hospitality); Mouride/Tidjaniyya brotherhoods (soft power); thiéboudienne UNESCO heritage; Sembène cinema legacy; Gorée slave trade memory.

legal_system.legal_tradition: Civil law (French system) with Islamic law influences
legal_system.sharia_applicability: Family Code influenced by Islamic principles (Muslim majority)
legal_system.notes: Multi-party democracy; 2024 peaceful transition after 2023 crisis; OHADA regional business law; strong legal tradition; Court of Cassation.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.

current_leader.title: President
current_leader.notes: Youngest president at 44; PASTEF party; ally of Ousmane Sonko; anti-establishment platform; won first round 2024; was in prison until weeks before election

prime_minister.name: Ousmane Sonko
prime_minister.notes: PASTEF leader; anti-corruption firebrand; mentor of Faye; political trials 2021–2023 sparked protests

former_leaders.notes: PS party; multiparty democracy expanded; Casamance conflict; lost to Wade in democratic alternance
